title: TypecheckDebtFile
description: Shape of typecheck-debt.json — the quarantine list for packages with known type errors. Drained package-by-package as AF2–AF5 fix errors. Remove an entry once a package reaches zero own errors.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference (optional, for editor tooling).

description.description: Human-readable summary of why this file exists.

packages.description: Map from package directory name (e.g. 'shared') to debt entry.

owner.description: Work-package ID responsible for draining this entry (e.g. 'AF2').

errors.description: Approximate own-error count at the time the entry was quarantined. Must stay >= 1 — an entry with 0 errors is stale and must be removed.

note.description: Short description of the error cluster (e.g. 'noUncheckedIndexedAccess in tests').
